subject: constructive learning and longitudinal source assessment

metadata_method.date_semantics: Commit author dates with their recorded offsets, not independently observed runtime or human-decision dates.

coverage.metadata: All reachable commits indexed for candidate selection; latest 600 examined as a bounded window, not 600 full diff reviews.
coverage.selection: Earlier governance and content pivots; repeated cleanup; method redesign and recovery; substantive positive content changes; recent tool failures. Purposive selection, not a representative statistical sample.
coverage.archive: Two available archive refs were counted relative to HEAD: 44 and 124 commits outside it. These are not summed because overlap was not established. The 124-commit branch metadata and compression map were read; its tip tree equals the corresponding consolidated tip. Neither archive received a full semantic audit.
unobserved: Real Windows scheduler and injected context
All source claims and external URLs
